args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; try { $root = $env:YOHAN_ECOSYSTEM_ROOT; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($root)) { $commonDocuments = [Environment]::GetFolderPath([Environment+SpecialFolder]::CommonDocuments); if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($commonDocuments)) { throw 'YOHAN_ECOSYSTEM_ROOT is not set and the Windows Public profile could not be resolved.' }; $root = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $commonDocuments) 'dev/yohan-ecosystem' }; $root = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($root); $env:YOHAN_BRAIN_ROOT = Join-Path $root 'yohan-brain'; $env:QDRANT_PATH = Join-Path $root 'yohan-mcp/.qdrant_storage'; $env:EMBED_BACKEND = 'ollama'; $env:EMBEDDING_MODEL = 'bge-m3'; $env:OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE = '2m'; $python = Join-Path $root 'yohan-mcp/.venv/Scripts/python.exe'; $server = Join-Path $root 'yohan-mcp/server.py'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $python -PathType Leaf)) { throw ('yohan MCP Python not found: ' + $python) }; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $server -PathType Leaf)) { throw ('yohan MCP server not found: ' + $server) }; & $python $server; $childExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($null -eq $childExitCode) { $childExitCode = 1 }; exit $childExitCode } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine($_.Exception.Message); exit 1 }
